index.title: Automate Meeting Attendance and Note-taking
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Meeting Attendance. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Meeting Attendance and Note-taking. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help,
index.what_happened_excerpt: The user set up a bot to attend a meeting on their behalf, informing attendees of its presence, taking notes, and sending updates to the user. This is a public pattern for automating meeting attendance and note-taking.
